chunk with a gap in the index -> JobRejected HashMismatch, state Idle
chunk repeating an index -> JobRejected HashMismatch, state Idle
chunk for another job_id -> Error UnknownJob, state Receiving
chunk with no job in assembly -> Error UnknownJob, state Idle
chunk above 262144 bytes -> JobRejected TooLarge, state Idle
chunks above announced bytes -> JobRejected TooLarge, state Idle
byte outside printable ASCII -> JobRejected NotAscii, state Idle
assembled text with another hash -> JobRejected HashMismatch, state Idle
